name: Joel Bennett
abstract_title: From Day to Destiny to Diamonds: The Neurotheology of Temporal Consciousness
abstract: Research on the human experience of time spans a wide range of levels, moving from studies of neural time scales in consciousness (Buccellato et al), reaction times in psychophysics, time perspectives in personality (Zimbardo), the relationship of time management to life satisfaction (Aeon et al), time disappearance in flow states and time dilation in near death experiences, and the role of time in mystical and transpersonal experiences.
